record_type_quote: All five labs used the same methodology, carefully replicating the experimental conditions of Levitin’s study.

targets.title: Absolute memory for musical pitch: Evidence from the production of learned melodies.
targets.evidence_quote: Up to now, no replication of Levitin’s (1994) study has been published. The aim of this paper is to present the results of a replication project across five different labs in Germany and the UK.
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication study supports basically the hypothesis that that there is a strong absolute component for pitch memory of very well-known tunes. However, a decline effect of results could be observed as well as some surprising pecularities, which need further clarification.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall verdict supports the original finding; weaker effects alone do not make it mixed.

reasoning: Identity and author order match the five-laboratory 2012 conference record. Only its extended abstract is available; the six-laboratory conference item and later journal paper are different records and were not substituted.
